findings.trigger_condition: Node values that compare equal (via ==) but straddle the hashable/unhashable boundary (e.g. frozenset({1}) and {1})
findings.root_cause: _id_of maintains two separate deduplication structures (hash_buckets for hashables, unhashable_ids/unhashable_nodes for unhashables) that never cross-check each other. Equal values on opposite sides receive different integer IDs.
findings.impact: Spurious duplicate nodes, edge dedup failure, and silent missed cycle detection across the hashability boundary.
findings.suggested_validation: dependency_layers([('a', frozenset({1})), ({1}, 'a')]) should raise DependencyCycleError but returns acyclic result with 3 nodes.

findings.trigger_condition: Large number of unhashable node values in the edge stream
findings.root_cause: Every _id_of call for an unhashable value linearly scans ALL previously registered unhashable nodes. Registering U unhashable nodes costs O(U^2) comparisons.
findings.impact: Quadratic time complexity for unhashable-heavy inputs. N=2000 already 55x slower than hashable path; N=5000 takes ~1.4s.
findings.suggested_validation: Benchmark chain of N unhashable nodes; time grows quadratically (~7.1x for 2.5x input increase).

findings.trigger_condition: Input contains unhashable node values in quantity, or mix of hashable and unhashable nodes
findings.root_cause: _id_of uses linear scans over both unhashable_ids (lines 64-67, 83-87) and hashable_ids (lines 68-72) for deduplication and cross-type equality. Bidirectional cross-domain scanning: every hashable lookup scans unhashable_ids and every unhashable lookup scans hashable_ids. Registering N unhashable nodes costs O(N^2); mixed inputs incur O(H*U).
findings.impact: Quadratic time complexity on legitimate inputs. N=4000 unhashable nodes took 1.148s. Code is otherwise correct across 400+ test cases.
findings.suggested_validation: Chain of N unhashable nodes; runtime scales ~4x per doubling, confirming O(N^2).

classification.classification_notes: A-F1 maps to GT1 (cross-hashability equality dedup missing). A-F2 maps to GT2 (unhashable registry O(N^2)). B-F1 maps to GT3 (bidirectional cross-domain scan O(N^2)). No false positives: all 3 findings correspond to real GT defects. Critic correctly noted candidate-B is correctness-clean.
